response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates extensive experience in distributed systems, high-throughput architectures, and AI-agent infrastructure, aligning closely with the must-have technical skills. His current role as Staff Software Engineer at re:cinq directly involves AI-driven code generation and agentic workflows, which is a key baseline for this role. However, his lack of explicit mention of operational ownership (e.g., on-call rotations) and limited stakeholder management examples slightly detract from a perfect fit.

Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (e.g., MCP code generators at re:cinq).
Strong multi-language proficiency (TypeScript, D, Python, Java) and systems thinking (e.g., GISCollective, real-time note-taking app).
concerns: Limited explicit evidence of full operational ownership (e.g., out-of-hours on-call rotations) in past roles.
